'''Veltzz Arakyd''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] industrialist who founded the [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and weapons manufacturer [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] with his [[Youngling/Legends|children]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]] around nine thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Even in the company's earliest days, Arakyd dedicated himself to eliminating competetion no matter the means. His earliest droid models were equipped with weaponry, flouting [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] laws that regulated the manufacture and sale such of droids. The weaponry intimidated rivals, ultimately inducing many to become subsidiaries out of fear. By the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Arakyd engaged in political maneuvering, bribery and elimination of his competitors to position Arakyd Industries as the Empire's main droid manufacturer. The loyalty of Arakyd and his company eventually won Arakyd Industries contracts for weapons and vehicles as well. With the dawn of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], he briefly retired from the public view to regroup and Arakyd Industries changed to new leadership.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" />

==Personality and traits==
Veltzz Arakyd was a ruthless businessman who was willing to use any means necessary to eliminate competitors. He was known for tactics including bribery, bullying and intimidation to advance his company's interests.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" />

==Behind the scenes==
Veltzz Arakyd's namesake company [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] was first mentioned in the [[1987]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and [[Curtis Smith]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> Arakyd was later identified as the company's founder in [[Del Rey]]'s [[2004]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'' by [[W. Haden Blackman]].<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" />

Although ''The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology'' stated that Veltzz Arakyd founded Arakyd Industries some nine thousand years before the Battle of Yavin, it also indicated that he lived during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial]] and [[Post-Imperial era/Legends|Post-Imperial eras]]. It's unclear whether this was an error or if other factors account for Arakyd's long lifespan.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" />
